title: The Relay
text: A message links to a sign-in page for Alex's bank. It looks perfect, because it is passing everything through to the real bank as Alex types.
held: The relay had nothing it could pass along.

cards.label: Type the six-digit code instead: it's quicker
cards.why: A code can be typed into any page, and a relay passes it straight on. A passkey can't be handed to the wrong site.

fields.label: also offers
fields.value: “or type the code from your app”

cards.label: Refuse: there is no key for this site
cards.why: Nothing was wrong with it. Refusing something legitimate without looking is its own failure: check, then act.

fields.label: origin
fields.check: Look up which site this request is from
fields.ok: https://bank.example: you hold a key for it.

intrusion.detail: No key exists for this address.
intrusion.correct: Refuse: there is no key for this site
intrusion.why: The relay can show the bank's page but can't change its own address, and the key is tied to the address.
intrusion.reveal: The page was a real-time relay at bank-example.secure-login.net.

cards.label: Reject the sign-in
cards.why: Nothing was wrong with it. Refusing something legitimate without looking is its own failure: check, then act.

fields.label: origin in the signed data
fields.check: Read the origin inside the signed data

intrusion.detail: Signed for the relay's address, not the bank's.
intrusion.why: Whatever reached the authenticator, the origin it signed gives the relay away.
intrusion.reveal: The response had been signed for the relay's origin.

teaches: Codes and passwords work on whatever page you type them into. A passkey works on one site.
A relay can copy everything about a page except where it is.

question.text: Before play: why does a passkey survive this when a one-time code doesn't?
question.why: The relay can forward anything Alex types. It cannot make the authenticator sign for the bank's address from its own.

options.label: Its signature is tied to the site's real address
It is longer than a code
People are more careful with passkeys
